name: Low-Carb Turkey and Cauliflower Rice Casserole with Mushrooms

fit.note: 472 cal is inside 400-650; 8.6g carbs well under 35g cap; turkey, no seafood; weigh-and-divide cauliflower-rice bake scales cleanly from 8 to 14 servings.

dupe_check.catalog: No turkey recipe in the 544-recipe catalog uses cauliflower rice. Nearest low-carb turkey bakes keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole (broccoli + cheddar) and turkey-zucchini-noodle-casserole (zoodles) differ in vegetable base AND sauce (this uses mozzarella + sour cream + mayo + Dijon); creamy-turkey-rice-mushroom-soup and turkey-tetrazzini share mushrooms only and are a soup and a pasta dish respectively. Not a duplicate.

cross_protein_collision: Source recipe explicitly says 'turkey OR chicken' - this is structurally a creamy low-carb poultry + cauliflower-rice + crimini mushroom bake. A chicken version would be the same dish. Decider should check the chicken pool for any 'low-carb chicken and cauliflower rice casserole with mushrooms / creamy sauce'.
